name: soia-dev-design
description: Design and document pipeline: PRDs and user stories, high-fidelity prototypes, architecture and sequence diagrams, VSDX-to-draw.io migration, and atomic Office file edits.

displayDescription.en: Takes a one-line need to a PRD, high-fidelity prototype, architecture and sequence diagrams, and edits Office files safely.
displayDescription.zh: 从一句话需求做到 PRD、高保真原型与架构图，并能安全改 Word、Excel、PPT 文件。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a one-line feature idea. Take it to a PRD with scope and acceptance criteria, then a prototype.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我只有一句话的功能想法，帮我做成有范围和验收标准的 PRD，再出个原型。

quickPrompts.en: I have a one-line feature idea. Take it to a PRD with scope and acceptance criteria, then a prototype.
quickPrompts.zh: 我只有一句话的功能想法，帮我做成有范围和验收标准的 PRD，再出个原型。

quickPrompts.en: Draw the architecture and sequence diagrams for this system.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这个系统画架构图和时序图。

quickPrompts.en: Migrate these Visio files to editable draw.io diagrams.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这些 Visio 文件转成可编辑的 draw.io 图表。
